pipeline.modality: Humanized IgG4 single-chain variable fragment bispecific antibody (engineered fusion of ixekizumab and tabalumab)
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from Eli Lilly and Company

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 in approximately 225 adults; 16-week double-blind period with optional OLE; primary endpoint percent change from baseline in abscess + inflammatory nodule count at Week 16
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING — initiated May 2025; topline 16-week results expected Q4 2026

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 in approximately 80 adults with early dcSSc; 24-week double-blind period; primary endpoint modified Rodnan Skin Score at Week 24
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING — initiated December 2024; topline 24-week results expected 1H 2027

excluded_preclinical.rationale: Anti-IL-7Rα mAb; previously evaluated in three Phase 1/1b trials by Pfizer. Currently between studies — Zura is assessing competitive landscape and disease selection; no active Zura-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trial.
Anti-IL-33 mAb; previously evaluated in three Lilly-sponsored clinical trials. Currently no active Zura-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 trial.
